items.q: How long does it take to issue the technical review report?
items.a: It depends on the project size and service type requested, averaging between 7 and 14 business days from receiving the complete drawings.

items.q: Is your report accepted by municipal authorities?
items.a: Yes, the report is issued in an official, documented format that can be used as part of the project file before the relevant authorities.

items.q: Do you offer a re-evaluation service after revisions?
items.a: Yes, once we receive the revised drawings we re-evaluate only the items previously flagged.

items.q: Is the service available to engineering firms on an ongoing basis?
items.a: We offer ongoing review partnerships for engineering firms with preferential pricing based on annual collaboration volume.

g.title: General Code Compliance
g.short: A unified report combining results from every discipline.
g.scope: Consolidates results from all discipline sheets into one compliance report ready for submission to relevant authorities, with an executive summary of key findings.

a.title: Architectural Design Review
a.short: Checking architectural drawings against municipal requirements.
a.scope: Review of plans, elevations, and sections to verify compliance with municipal requirements and the residential building code, including setbacks, ratios, and uses.
deliverables: List of setback violations, if any

s.title: Structural Design Review
s.scope: Review of structural drawings, column grid, and structural calculations to confirm adequate sections and compliance with the loading code and seismic resistance.

e.title: Electrical Systems Review
e.scope: Review of panels, loads, circuits, and cable routing, and verification of grounding and electrical safety standards for the residential building.

m.title: HVAC Systems Review
m.short: Assessing ventilation and air conditioning efficiency.
m.scope: Review of duct routing, unit locations, and ventilation rates to confirm distribution efficiency and compliance with indoor air quality requirements.

p.title: Plumbing & Sanitary Drainage
p.short: Review of water supply and sanitary drainage networks.
p.scope: Review of supply and sanitary drainage drawings and vertical shaft locations, and verification of slopes and diameters against the plumbing code.

fp.title: Fire Protection & Safety
fp.short: Checking alarm systems and evacuation routes.
fp.scope: Review of evacuation routes, exit widths, and alarm/extinguishing device locations, and confirmation of compliance with safe egress distances.

ee.title: Energy Efficiency & Thermal Insulation
ee.short: Assessing insulation compliance and energy efficiency requirements.
ee.scope: Review of wall and roof insulation thickness and type, and calculation of thermal transmittance to confirm compliance with energy efficiency requirements.
